summary: UC2: Member receives push notification and navigates to RSVP
user_story: As a network or community member, I want to tap an event push notification and land directly on the RSVP page, so I can commit to attending in one action.
preconditions: User has push notifications enabled on their device
Admin has triggered an event creation push for an audience that includes this user
entry_points: A. Push notification tapped on mobile device

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Tap navigates to event RSVP page
given: A user receives an event creation push notification
then: They are navigated to that event's RSVP page

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Event deleted before user taps push
given: An event creation push was sent
acceptance_criteria.when: The event is deleted (isDeleted = true) before the user taps AND the user taps the push notification
then: They see "This event is no longer available"
They are not shown an error or blank screen

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Push suppressed by device-level notification settings
given: A user has disabled push notifications at the device or OS level
acceptance_criteria.when: An event creation push is triggered for their audience segment
then: They do not receive the push
They still receive the in-app tray notification per existing behavior

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Virtual event — no duplicate push from auto-generated Room
given: An event is a virtual event (Room auto-generated on creation)
acceptance_criteria.when: The admin sends the event creation push
then: Only ONE push notification is delivered to each eligible user
The Room/livestream-creation push notification is suppressed
acceptance_criteria.reference: Per existing rule: SDD RSVP to Events & Event Reminders, UC4

given: An event creation push is sent
acceptance_criteria.when: The push is delivered and displayed on the user's device
then: The push title reads "{{CommunityName}} has event {{EventName}}"
The push body shows an event type chip ("In-person" or "Virtual") followed by the event start date and start time
The notification icon displays the community avatar
